concepts.title: Ability ranks
concepts.model: New progression: spend points to raise Weapon, Special, or Burst through five authored ranks.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high-fidelity game UI concept, matching the quality of the supplied Survivors of Victory reference images. These are reference images for a redesigned interface, not a request to reproduce their exact layout. Image 1 defines the desired visual craft: strong condensed typography, illustrated hexagonal skill icons, character portrait, navy tactical glass, crisp silver/cyan edges, selected gold accents, generous negative space, beautiful ability artwork. Image 2 supplies the actual paused 3D test range and combat HUD context. Keep this world and Snow White's white-haired, grey-hooded NIKKE identity. A landscape-only game: no phone frame, no portrait layout. Show the interface filling most of the screen but inset from every edge, with the battlefield and a little dimmed combat HUD visible around it. The interface must feel like a finished game screen, not a website dashboard, spreadsheet, wireframe, or form. Avoid plain text-only rectangles, repeated heavy outlines, rainbow colors, giant empty dark areas, excessive glow and unreadable microtext. Use visual hierarchy, strong iconic silhouettes and art. Keep exact short labels legible. Return one finished screenshot, no collage, no explanatory poster, no watermark.
Aspect ratio 16:9, requested 1920x1080. Main concept: NO TREE. Three beautiful ability upgrade cards side by side, with a compact integrated header. A white-haired Snow White portrait anchors the header: "ABILITY UPGRADES", "SNOW WHITE", "LV 6", "2 SP", subtle "PAUSED", close X. The layout must be instantly readable.
Each card has a large distinctive illustrated ability vignette at top: WEAPON = her white sci-fi sniper rifle with a cyan projectile; SPECIAL = her squat twin-pod missile turret in the overgrown plaza; BURST = Snow White releasing a luminous cyan cone blast. Use the warm gold / cyan balance and polished art composition of the references, not generic stock weapon symbols. The vignettes should occupy roughly the upper half of each card and fade into navy below. Compact hex category emblems can overlap the art edge.
Left card selected in restrained gold: "WEAPON", "SEVEN DWARVES", "RANK 2 / 5". Five rank pips with exactly two filled. Current short line "Marked rounds • explosive kills". Strong NEXT section: "RANK 3 — AFTERBURN", "Shots leave a damaging fire trail." Large clear button "UPGRADE • 1 SP". Small future hint "Next: Burning + Slow".
Middle card silver/cyan trim: "SPECIAL", "AUTO-TURRET", "RANK 3 / 5". Exactly three of five rank pips filled. Current line "Missile turrets • damaging aura". NEXT: "RANK 4 — INCENDIARY ARSENAL", "Missiles burn and mark targets." Secondary button "UPGRADE • 1 SP".
Right card silver/cyan trim: "BURST", "SEVEN DWARVES", "RANK 1 / 5". Exactly one of five rank pips filled. Current line "Wide cone blast". NEXT: "RANK 2 — FULLY ACTIVE", "Burn enemies • kills can refill Burst". Secondary button "UPGRADE • 1 SP".
Use crisp rank badges and clear current-to-next separation, not paragraphs. No prerequisite wires, no skill points attached to individual little talent nodes, no separate mastery panel. The old talents are bundled into rank upgrades; choosing which ability receives a point is the decision. Bottom small helper "Choose an ability to improve." A discreet "VIEW RANK PLAN" link and "TAB  RESUME". Preserve space around all controls, beautiful restrained composition.

Aspect ratio 21:9 ultrawide, requested 2520x1080. Main concept: NO BRANCHING TREE. Weapon row EXACTLY five medallions: "Seven Dwarves" (owned), "Marked Rounds" (owned), "Afterburn" (selected NEXT, bright gold), "Burning + Slow" (future, dim), "Charged Finale" (future, dim). A single straight horizontal rail links them in order.
Special row EXACTLY five: "Auto-Turret" (owned), "Expanded Arsenal" (owned), "Defensive Line" (owned), "Incendiary Arsenal" (next), "Permanent Battery" (future).
Burst row EXACTLY five: "Seven Dwarves" (owned), "Fully Active" (next), "Focused Fire" (future), "Pierce + Stun" (future), "Goddess Protocol" (future).
Owned stages cyan check medallions; each row's next stage silver and only the selected Weapon rank 3 gold; future stages dark desaturated but their names still visible. No forked connections, no per-node prerequisites beyond previous rank.
Bottom selected-upgrade strip: small beautiful gameplay illustration of Snow White's shot leaving a cold cyan fire trail, "WEAPON • RANK 2 → 3", heading "AFTERBURN", one line "Shots leave a damaging fire trail.", clear gold button "UPGRADE • 1 SP". Footer "Spend points on any ability. Each upgrade advances one rank." and "TAB  RESUME". Keep stage names legible, no paragraphs in the tracks, no extra ranks.

Aspect ratio 16:9, requested 1920x1080. Main concept: CHARACTER LEVEL MILESTONES, no tree and no spending. This is an elegant ability evolution preview inside the paused action game. Header "ABILITY EVOLUTION", Snow White portrait, "CHARACTER LEVEL 8", "PAUSED". Absolutely no SP currency, point counters, Learn buttons or Upgrade purchase buttons anywhere.
A beautiful single horizontal milestone ribbon across the upper portion has exactly five labeled stops: "LV 1", "LV 5", "LV 10", "LV 15", "LV 20". First two stops completed cyan; LV10 next with a gold outline; future two muted. Progress marker labeled "YOU • LV 8" sits between LV5 and LV10. Clear concise line "NEXT EVOLUTION AT LEVEL 10".
Under it, three large art-led ability panels with beautiful painterly sci-fi illustrations that match the references: left WEAPON with Snow White's white rifle and frost-blue fire trail; center SPECIAL with her missile turret radiating a blue defensive ring; right BURST with a concentrated cyan beam. Large simple category labels, steel/cyan frames, one selected gold emphasis only.
Each panel clearly separates CURRENT and NEXT:
WEAPON: "NOW — MARKED ROUNDS" / "Marks + explosive kills"; below "AT LV 10 — AFTERBURN" / "Shots leave fire trails".
SPECIAL: "NOW — EXPANDED ARSENAL" / "More turrets + more missiles"; below "AT LV 10 — DEFENSIVE LINE" / "Turrets gain a damaging aura".
BURST: "NOW — FULLY ACTIVE" / "Burning blast + gauge recovery"; below "AT LV 10 — FOCUSED FIRE" / "Hold to focus a stronger blast".
Current states are white/cyan, next milestone labels softly gold. Artwork about 45% of each panel, readable text and generous whitespace. Small tasteful footer "Abilities evolve automatically as you level up." One clear "RESUME" button only. Preserve a visible battlefield margin. This should feel clean, sophisticated and cinematic, NOT an auto-battler or a character-selection screen.

concepts.title: Illustrated hex tree
concepts.model: Existing progression: six individual upgrades per category, authored prerequisites, and free mastery after all seven talents.

Aspect ratio 16:9, requested 1920x1080. Main concept: improve the existing HEX TALENT TREE with the same richly illustrated craft as reference image 1, while keeping clean composition. This is the comparison option that retains the current prerequisite system. Use an airy network of large illustrated hex medallions floating over a dimmed battlefield, not nodes as rectangular text cards. Keep a graceful, compact header: Snow White portrait, "RUN TALENTS", "SNOW WHITE • LV 6", "2 SP", "PAUSED", and three icon tabs "WEAPON" selected gold, "SPECIAL", "BURST". A close X and bottom "TAB  RESUME".
Left roughly 65% is a tree with EXACTLY SEVEN non-mastery nodes and EXACT dependencies:
Top center root "SEVEN DWARVES" owned cyan with a white rifle icon.
The root has three children only: left middle "WEAK POINT" owned cyan with a targeting illustration, center middle "AFTERBURN" owned cyan with a tracer/fire illustration, right middle "EXPLOSIVE ROUNDS" available silver with a blast illustration.
Afterburn alone has three children: lower left "BURNING" selected gold with an elegant flame illustration, lower center "CHARGING" available silver with an expanding shot illustration, lower right "INFERNO" available silver with flame/slow illustration.
Use slim clear links precisely matching those six dependencies. Vary spacing gracefully so the tree feels designed, with big readable names outside the hexagons and small owned check marks. No repeated 0/1 numbers on every node. Glows subtle, not neon everywhere.
Beneath the tree is a separate refined horizontal gold-accent mastery plaque: "UNYIELDING", "3 / 7 TALENTS", "Automatic when the branch is complete". Do not connect mastery to only one node.
Right approximately 30%: beautiful dark-navy selected-ability panel. Large gold flame emblem, heading "BURNING". Concise effect "Fire burns enemies for 5× attack damage over 5s." Requirement line "Requires: Afterburn ✓". A large beautiful illustrated gameplay preview of Snow White firing through Raptures and leaving a cold-blue burning trail in the same overgrown stone plaza. Gold primary button "LEARN • 1 SP". A tiny three-state key at bottom only if it fits cleanly. Preserve readable text, luminous metal/glass edges and the character artwork quality of the references. Do not introduce extra talents, currencies, randomized offers or extra windows.
